title: nepeta rigida
intro: Nepeta rigida, commonly known as Catmint, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, thanks to its health benefits such as promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta rigida are attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of restlessness, tremors, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoid alkaloids, which contribute to its calming and soothing properties.
